verdict.rationale: No evidence anywhere in the pack of a published acceptable-use policy, anti-abuse terms, or guidance on permissible use of the stealth/CAPTCHA-bypass and automation features; docs only describe how to use auto-CAPTCHA and proxy features, not what usage is disallowed. Community commentary even calls out the lack of any such framing (e.g., accusing the marketing of enabling spambots), reinforcing the absence rather than disputing a claim.
